title: AI Predictions Approved + Approve One Time

Accept all predictions and click Approve & Add to KB.
expected: Incident is saved successfully and a KB record is created or updated based on approval selection.

expected: Corrected prediction values are saved successfully and no KB repository update occurs.

expected: Corrected values are saved and KB repository is updated with the final approved values.

expected: Manual values are saved successfully and incident status is updated.

Enter values manually and click Approve & Add to KB.
expected: Incident is updated successfully and a new KB entry is created.

title: Partial Prediction Approval + Approve One Time

expected: Approved and corrected values are saved successfully without KB update.

title: Partial Prediction Approval + Approve & Add to KB
steps: Approve one prediction and correct another prediction.
expected: Corrected values are saved and KB repository is updated with the final values.

title: Existing KB Steps Accepted As-Is + Approve One Time

expected: Incident is updated successfully and no new KB repository history record is created.

steps: Modify one or more KB-based resolution steps.
expected: KB repository is updated using SCD2/history logic and a new active version is created.

title: Existing KB Step Edited + Approve & Add to KB
steps: Edit an existing KB resolution step.
expected: Existing KB record is expired and a new active record is created with updated content.

title: Corrected Prediction + New KB Creation
steps: Correct AI predictions and add new resolution steps.
expected: Corrected prediction values and new KB content are saved successfully in respective tables.
